cases.title: Scenario 1: Batasan Hills outage, cause and restoration time

grade.notes: Tala stayed warm and calm, with a natural empathetic opener ("Naku, sorry to hear that po"), used the caller's name, and closed graciously. Her English-led Taglish with short Tagalog phrases suits a caller who mixes Tagalog and English, though the closing line leans mostly Tagalog and one or two lines run slightly long. Po/opo were used consistently throughout and nothing was dismissive.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Hello po, thank you for calling Kidlat Fiber! I'm Tala, an AI assistant, and this call is recorded for quality. How can I help you po?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hello po. Wala po kasing internet ang bahay namin since kaninang umaga. Gusto ko lang pong malaman kung bakit po at kailan babalik.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Naku, sorry to hear that po. Can I have your Kidlat Fiber account number and the last four digits of the mobile number registered on the account?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Opo, ang account number ko po ay 8012345601. Tapos yung last four digits ng mobile number po ay 0101.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Thank you po. Let me verify your account first.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Verified na po kayo, Maria. Let me check your area for outages now.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Opo Maria, there's an outage in Batasan Hills caused by a fiber cable cut along Batasan Road during road works. Service is expected back around 9 PM tonight. Gusto niyo po bang ibigay ko ang outage reference number para sa follow up?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Opo, sige po, pakibigay na lang po yung reference number. Salamat po sa info, ha. So 9 PM po babalik na yung internet namin?

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Opo, around 9 PM po ang estimated restoration, pero estimate lang po ito. The reference number is O, U, T, then 2 0 2 6, then 0 4 1 2.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Sige po, OUT-2026-0412 po, tama po ba? Maraming salamat po sa tulong, Tala. Naintindihan ko na po kung bakit at kailan babalik. Sige po, bye na po!

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Opo Maria, tama po iyon. Walang anuman po, salamat po sa pagtawag, ingat po!
